info.title: Tracecart API
info.description: REST API for the Tracecart store, customer accounts, back office, Seller Center and Partner portal. Each operation's x-tracecart-access says who may call it: public, session, account, or a permission.

bearerAuth.description: A Clerk session token for a user linked to a Tracecart account.

get.summary: The signed-in user
get.description: 401: not signed in, or the Clerk session is invalid. 403: signed in with Clerk, but no Tracecart account is linked to that email.

get.summary: Carrier services — who carries what, from where to which country, within which limits and transit time, at which rates. An admin sees all; a carrier its own.

post.summary: Create a carrier service, with its limits, transit times and rate card

get.summary: Carrier accounts, and whether each has signed in yet (Super Admin).

post.summary: Add a carrier account (linked at its first sign-in by email)

patch.summary: Change a carrier account's name, phone or language (Super Admin). The email is how they sign in, so it stays.

Change a service's limits, transit time, rate card or priority (admin only), or switch it off. Orders already routed keep their carrier; those still being quoted from the rate card take the new rates.

get.summary: Every version of a service's rates, latest first — what each rate-card quote was priced with (its carrier or an admin).

Groupages — orders on one carrier service sent together. The hub's administrateur sees each group's load, its cost and what it saves against sending the orders alone; a carrier sees the groups on its services, with the load and its price, never the saving.

post.summary: Form a consolidation of paid orders on one carrier service

get.summary: Where grouping pays — per carrier service, the paid orders not yet in a group, what sending them together would save, and the open group they could join; biggest saving first (Super Admin).
A group, as the administrateur or its carrier sees it.

patch.summary: Set a forming consolidation's agreed cost and notes

post.summary: Move the group's orders one step together, each through its own transition — CONFIRMED_HUB (the hub hands them over), PICKED_UP (the carrier; every order must be handed over, and the group is then dispatched with its cost fixed), IN_TRANSIT (the carrier). Delivery stays per order. Answers which orders moved, which were skipped (not at the step before) and which failed.
Cancel a forming consolidation; its orders travel alone again

get.summary: Orders that could join this open group now (Super Admin).

post.summary: Record a shipment milestone for every order in the group — same body and rules as POST /orders/{id}/events, and each customer is told as if it were recorded on their order alone. With an idempotencyKey (or Idempotency-Key header), a retry records nothing new.
Add orders to a forming consolidation

delete.summary: Remove an order from a forming consolidation

get.summary: The signed-in customer's profile

post.summary: The customer account for this Clerk session, created on first call from the verified email. Staff emails are refused (409).

get.summary: The customer's own requests and where each stands

post.summary: Send a product request from the website, with the customer's pick and a photo or video

Ask Tracecart to move goods the customer already has (multipart `what`, `quantity`, `shipment` as JSON — pickup and delivery addresses, cargo as far as known, ready and needed-by dates, who handles customs — and an optional `photo`). Contact details come from the account.

Buy an offer a search found (the customer's own account, with a phone) — an ordinary order priced as shown with today's rates, a reservation of the listing, and a request on the account. Staff check with the store, send the quote and buy by hand.

Product suggestions for a description and/or one photo or video (multipart `what`, `photo` up to 5 MB, or `video` — MP4, MOV or WebM, up to 20 MB and 30 s), searched live and ranked by accuracy then price. With `country` (two letters), each is priced delivered there and comes with a signed `offer` to buy it with (POST /customer/shop/buy). Uploads are screened first. Nothing is stored. Limited per account.

get.summary: The hub's exceptions, open first, most severe first (Super Admin).

The visitor's country from their IP, for the site's language, prices and delivery (public). The web app asks the browser for the location first and uses this when that's refused or fails. Answers the country code (null when unknown) and the language Tracecart speaks there.
Best-effort location from the caller's IP, plus the nearest active hub if one is within range
Liveness: Postgres and Redis are reachable
List active hubs

post.summary: Create a hub
post.description: Left out, the country code comes from the country, and the position and time zone from the city.

patch.summary: Bind the current user to a hub, or create one and bind to it
Set the language the current user's notifications are written in
patch.description: The console sends the language it is shown in.

get.summary: List the current user's notifications, newest first
Count of unread in-app notifications for the current user
List orders (role-scoped — Super Admin sees their hub's orders with full pricing, Partner sees only assigned parcels, price-free)

post.summary: Create an intent (Super Admin only). Inherits the admin's hub; auto-assigns a partner and moves straight to QUOTING.

get.summary: Order counts grouped by store or by destination city (data-driven, no hardcoded cities). No pricing — safe for both roles.
Current count and time-in-stage (avg/p90 age) for every open pipeline stage — the bottleneck/leading-indicator view. No pricing — safe for both roles.
*   get:
Orders created vs delivered over time, bucketed by day/week/month, with a previous-period series for overlay comparison. No pricing — safe for both roles.
Get a single order (role-scoped serialization)

patch.summary: Edit product/customer/quantity/notes and enter productCost while quoting (Super Admin only)

put.summary: Set one of the order's typed addresses (PICKUP, SUPPLIER_ORIGIN, DELIVERY, BILLING). DELIVERY also updates the order's destination. Super Admin; before the quote is sent.

delete.summary: Remove one of an order's addresses

patch.summary: Cargo as it travels (packages, dimensions, weight, declared value, handling flags, ready and required-by dates). Medical devices and dangerous goods put the order under compliance review. Super Admin; before the quote is sent.

put.summary: Record the compliance review (APPROVED or BLOCKED need a note). A quote can't be sent while a review is pending or the order is blocked.
Create or update the order's customs case (responsibility, status, estimated/official duties, broker fee, classification proposal, documents).

post.summary: Record a shipment milestone that happened (Super Admin of the hub, or the assigned carrier), from payment until delivery (after it, only RETURN_STARTED). A delay or a failed delivery needs a reason; a revised ETA needs the new window. Send an idempotencyKey (or Idempotency-Key header) so a retry records nothing twice — the replay answers 200 instead of 201. The customer is told about the milestones that concern them; a repeated, unchanged delay isn't sent again. Delays, failed deliveries and missing customs documents open an exception.
Open an exception on an order (Super Admin). One open exception per type and order.

patch.summary: Update an open exception's owner, next action, due date, severity or customer impact (Super Admin).

post.summary: Resolve an exception, saying how (Super Admin).
Set/override the platform fee for an order (Super Admin only). If never called, send-quote computes a default from PLATFORM_FEE_PERCENT.

get.summary: Full status timeline for an order

post.summary: Report the shipment's current position (Logistics Partner only, while they hold the shipping leg). Always recorded with source=MANUAL.
Submit (or revise) the itemized logistics quote for an order (Partner, or Super Admin on a CUSTOMER_OWNED order). Never exposes product cost or platform fee.
Confirm the customer's payment (Super Admin only). Notifies the partner to prepare.
Upload photos of the physical goods (Super Admin only). Up to 6 images, 8MB each.

get.summary: View a photo. Redirects to a signed storage URL valid for 5 minutes. Same access as viewing the order.

post.summary: Upload proof-of-delivery photos (the assigned carrier, or Super Admin), once the parcel is on its way. The customer sees them on their link after delivery.

get.summary: The quote the order would get if sent now — every line with its component, whether it is Tracecart revenue or a pass-through cost, how sure it is, the pricing rule version behind it, and the notes (Super Admin only).
The price-free view of an order a partner has been asked to quote (Partner only)

post.summary: Route the order with a carrier service that fits it (and meets a hard deadline), before the quote is sent. A different carrier replaces the carrier quote and is asked to quote.

get.summary: Every active carrier service as it would serve this order — whether it fits and why not, limits not yet checkable, arrival window, on time for the deadline (Super Admin).

post.summary: Price the order (product, carrier quote, fee, pricing rules, customs) and send it to the customer as a new quote version, valid QUOTE_VALIDITY_DAYS (Super Admin only). Requires productCost (purchases), a logistics quote, and no pending or failed compliance review.
Manually change an order's status. Admin can move to most statuses (note required); Partner can only advance CONFIRMED_HUB → ... → DELIVERED.

get.summary: Pricing rules — the latest version of each, or every version with history=true. Super Admin.

post.summary: Create a pricing rule (version 1)
Stop a rule applying from now on (kept in the history).
Change a rule by adding its next version; the current version stops applying. Quotes already sent keep the version they used.

get.summary: What prices are built from beyond carrier rates — the hub's margins, exchange rates, customs rates, category defaults (Super Admin).

put.summary: The packed weight and size assumed for a product of this category without its own (Super Admin).

delete.summary: Remove a category's default weight and size

post.summary: Add duties and taxes for a destination and product category (or any), with the broker fee (Super Admin).

put.summary: Set the rate for a currency pair (1 currency = rate toCurrency); it converts both ways (Super Admin).
Another hub's store-to-hub rate, per order and per kg in its currency (Super Admin).
The hub's margins — fee tiers on the product and their minimum, markup on transport, buffer on the product (Super Admin).

get.summary: What the shop still needs before it can price a product (hub, routes with rates, exchange rates), and what is recommended (Super Admin).
List providers (store registry). SUPER_ADMIN may pass includeInactive=true to also see disabled stores.

post.summary: Register a new supported store

get.summary: Resolve a pasted product URL to a provider and best-effort product metadata
Keyword search a store's catalog (only supported for stores whose adapter implements search)
The customer's quote/tracking page data (no auth). Never includes cost, fee, or margin.

post.summary: Customer accepts or declines the quote (no auth)

get.summary: A proof-of-delivery photo for the customer holding the link, once the order is delivered (no auth). Redirects to a signed URL valid for 5 minutes.
Readiness: dependencies reachable and no migration unfinished or failed
get.description: For load balancers: send traffic only when this answers 200.

get.summary: List saved products for the admin's hub (Super Admin only)

post.summary: Save a product for later (Super Admin only) — no customer/destination needed yet

get.summary: Most-reserved stores for the admin's hub, in the window — Super Admin only
*   get:

delete.summary: Remove a reservation that hasn't been converted to an order yet

get.summary: Products the shop shows before anyone searches (public) — a few popular needs searched live and cached a day, priced delivered to `country` (two letters), each with a signed offer when it can be priced. `pending` while they're being searched.
An offer priced again delivered to a country, for a quantity. Public, since the offer is signed; it lasts 24 hours.
List sourcing requests for the admin's hub (Super Admin only)

post.summary: Log a company's sourcing need (Super Admin only) — no product link required yet

get.summary: Get one sourcing request

patch.summary: Select a candidate product, close, or annotate a sourcing request

post.summary: Add photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF) or PDF datasheets — up to 8 per request, 10 MB each. The file's bytes must match its type.

delete.summary: Remove a file from the request

get.summary: Redirect to a short-lived signed link for the file (files are never public)

post.summary: Add a supplier offer researched by staff (link, title, optional price and currency)

patch.summary: Choose (SELECTED), reject (REJECTED) or reset (PROPOSED) a candidate. Choosing one marks the request "candidate chosen"; nothing is bought.

get.summary: Discovery state of a request — inputs, product spec, search providers and their availability, ranked candidates, last search run

post.summary: Read the description, identifiers, photos and datasheets into a structured product spec with Claude. Values carry their source (observed / stated / inferred); unknowns stay empty.

get.summary: Search the catalog for candidate products matching this request's description/category/budget

post.summary: Search every enabled provider, then normalise, de-duplicate and rank the listings. Unavailable or failing providers are reported, never faked.

put.summary: Replace the product spec with a corrected one (validated like Claude's)
